name: text-random-tilt-scale-in
title: Random Tilt Scale In
description: Từng ký tự nhỏ, nghiêng ngẫu nhiên đứng thẳng dậy và lớn về đúng cỡ.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Split chars; each from scale 0.6 and a seeded rotation within ±20° → 1, 0°, opacity full by 40 % (×2.5), 0.9 s power4.out (easeOutQuint), stagger 80 ms (demo capped 0.7 s total), from 0.3 s. Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s inCubic; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.9 s) · stagger (0.08 s) · scale đầu (0.6) · tilt: góc nghiêng ngẫu nhiên (±20°) · ease (power4.out).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự nghiêng nhỏ đứng thẳng dậy
